criteria.quote: Add a priority attribute to the todo task
checks: priority is stored with the task
priority is shown on the task as a chip
a repeating task's next occurrence keeps its priority
priority filter shows only tasks of that priority
summary notes how many are shown when a priority filter is on
priority filter combines with the status and tag filters
Any priority clears the priority filter
new task form sets the priority
priority select resets to Medium after adding
criteria.mutation: const add2 = taskStore.add; taskStore.add = (d, t) => add2(d, { ...t, priority: 'medium' });

checks: edit form shows the current priority
editing changes the priority and persists it
criteria.mutation: const upd2 = taskStore.update; taskStore.update = (d, t) => upd2(d, { ...t, priority: undefined });

criteria.requirement: Three levels (High, Medium, Low); new tasks and tasks saved before priorities existed are Medium
checks: new tasks default to Medium priority
tasks saved before priorities existed show as Medium

criteria.requirement: Sort stays due date first; on the same date, priority breaks the tie (High first)
checks: same due date: High sorts before Medium before Low
due date still sorts before priority
an edited priority re-sorts the task
criteria.mutation: compareTasks = (a, b) => (a.dueDate === b.dueDate ? a.createdAt - b.createdAt : !a.dueDate ? 1 : !b.dueDate ? -1 : a.dueDate < b.dueDate ? -1 : 1);
